feed.title: Reducing Bitcoin Full Node Storage Without Consensus Changes

entry.title: Reducing Bitcoin Full Node Storage Without Consensus Changes
entry.summary:
RocksDB has become a common choice among various alternative node implementations, with multiple projects adopting it as their primary storage solution. This trend is shaping the development approaches within the ecosystem, reflecting a movement toward standardized and robust data management strategies.
The satd project also leverages RocksDB, but its approach aligns more closely with traditional storage philosophies inspired by Core. While this method does not prioritize space optimization, it acknowledges the growing importance of efficient storage, especially given that many newer implementations are incorporating indices. The inclusion of these indices inevitably leads to increased storage requirements, highlighting the need for ongoing exploration into methods that can balance performance and storage efficiency.
Further investigation into space-saving techniques remains a promising direction, particularly as storage demands continue to rise in step with advances in node functionality and complexity.
